guarantees.claim: fifo_empty_negedge is asserted when fifo_empty_q is high and fifo_empty is low (falling edge detection).
fifo_full_posedge is asserted when fifo_full_q is low and fifo_full is high (rising edge detection).

fifo_full_seen_d is cleared (0) if any of reg_hash_start, reg_hash_continue, reg_hash_process, reg_hash_stop is high; else cleared if fifo_empty_negedge is high; else set to 1 if fifo_full_posedge is high; otherwise holds fifo_full_seen_q.
fifo_empty_gate is high (interrupt mask) when msg_allowed is low or fifo_full_seen_q is low; otherwise low (interrupt unmasked) when both are high.
status_fifo_empty outputs 0 when fifo_empty_gate is high; otherwise passes through fifo_empty.

assumptions.claim: fifo_empty_q and fifo_full_q are synchronous, one-cycle delayed versions of fifo_empty and fifo_full, respectively.
assumptions.risk: If not properly registered, edge detection may miss transitions or produce glitches, breaking the full-seen tracking and interrupt gating.

assumptions.claim: msg_allowed is asserted only when software is permitted to write the message FIFO.
assumptions.risk: If msg_allowed is erroneously high when FIFO not writable, the interrupt could be unmasked prematurely; if erroneously low, the interrupt may be permanently gated even when software could react.

uncertain_points.claim: When msg_allowed is low (interrupt masked), a fifo_empty_negedge still clears fifo_full_seen tracking. If later msg_allowed becomes high while FIFO is empty and no new full event occurs, the past full condition may be lost, potentially causing a missed interrupt.
uncertain_points.cond: msg_allowed low, then goes high; FIFO had become full earlier and then emptied
uncertain_points.risk: Software may not be notified of a previous FIFO-full situation that resolved, leading to stall or missed reaction.

uncertain_points.claim: The registered version of fifo_full_seen_q (not in this chunk) updates on a later cycle than the combinational fifo_full_seen_d. There may be a race if a hash command clears the tracking on the same cycle that a fifo_full_posedge occurs, depending on when the register samples.
uncertain_points.cond: hash command pulse and fifo_full_posedge in same clock cycle
uncertain_points.risk: A full event could be missed if the clearing overrides the set before the flop captures it, breaking the full-seen tracking for that window.
